verdict.rationale: Ente's live llms.txt states its apps and server are open source. The docs link to the public github.com/ente/ente repository, and a community member thanks the team for releasing it open source, so the source is readable under an open-source arrangement. missing for 10: the specific license name and terms, and direct documentation of the Auth app's source location and license file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
